buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid.

2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Generic NON DISCLOSURE DECLARATION CERTIFICATE (On Bidder Letter Head) to be uploaded with bid: 1. I M/s. ___________________ hereby declare that I shall not disclose the contract or any provision, specification, plan, design, pattern, sample or information thereof to any third party during and after expiry of Contract. 2. If defying the norms as per the Contract a legal action may be taken against me as per the existing Rules. 4. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 5. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 6. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 7. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses (a) The bidder has to upload the certificate of acceptance of all the terms and conditions of the bidalongwit h the bid reference number. (b) Items will be delivered as per the specifications mentioned by the user. (c) Bids submitted by different firms from the same IP address will be rejected.

(d) Missing details, if any, will assumed as per good Engineering practice and will be provided by the vend or after being approved by Commanding Officer 115 Engineer Regiment. (e) Quoted cost should include cost of transportation and testing of Installation of equipment at site. (f) In case of any ambiguity in any given technical specification Vendor must clarify the same from CO 115 Engineer Regiment or detailed Engineer rep before participation in bid through representation on GeM. (g). Proof of Origin & Authenticity-Original Invoices: The Seller must submit the Original OEM Invoices /Bills for the equipment to verify genuineness and track warranty support. (h) The bidder has to upload the fwg documents :- 1. TAN Number 2. UDYAM (MSE) Rejgistration if applicable 3. Company incorporation certificate. 4. ITR Filings for previous 3 years. 5. Declaration regarding non-blacklisting certificate 6. Details about company including date of incorporation, address, email address, contact info, Annual turn over. (i) The supplied tractor shall be inspected at delivery for conformity with the accepted bid, OEM model d etails, specified dimensions/tyres, accessories and supplied documents. (j) The supplier shall demonstrate basic operation of the engine, transmission, brakes, steering, PTO, hyd raulic lift, electrical system and lighting during inspection. (k) The supplier shall hand over the OEM warranty documents, operator/maintenance manual, standard tool kit, insurance policy and all applicable registration/delivery documents. (l) The tractor shall be accepted only after verification that the supplied unit and accessories conform to th e accepted technical offer and the requirements of the contract. (m) The quoted price shall include the tractor, all specified accessories, applicable taxes/charges, delivery to the consignee location as specified in the GeM bid, and one year of comprehensive insurance. Any item stated as mandatory in this TS shall be supplied with the tractor without additional cost. .
